description: This file implements a Telegram polling session class for managing long-polling interactions with the Telegram API, including error handling, retries, and stall detection.

classes.name: TelegramPollingSession
classes.description: Manages a Telegram polling session, including starting, stopping, error handling, and stall detection.

methods.name: waitForGracefulStop
methods.description: Waits for a stop function to complete or a grace period to elapse.

methods.name: runUntilAbort
methods.description: Main loop to run polling until the abort signal is triggered.

methods.name: markForceRestarted
methods.description: Marks the session for a forced restart.

methods.name: markTransportDirty
methods.description: Marks the transport state as dirty, prompting a rebuild.

methods.name: createPollingBot
methods.description: Creates a new Telegram bot instance for polling.

methods.name: ensureWebhookCleanup
methods.description: Ensures that the webhook is cleaned up before polling.

methods.name: confirmPersistedOffset
methods.description: Confirms the last update ID has been persisted.

methods.name: runPollingCycle
methods.description: Runs a single polling cycle, including stall detection and error handling.

methods.name: waitBeforeRestart
methods.description: Implements exponential backoff before restarting polling.

methods.name: waitBeforeRetryOnRecoverableSetupError
methods.description: Retries after recoverable setup errors with delay.
